decisions.mark: names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the primitive that stops the compiler from knowing a value, and locates it in library/constant_time_impl.h
explains that the asm path is an EMPTY asm volatile statement with the value as an input-output register operand — it emits no instruction and exists solely as an optimisation barrier
states that when assembly is unavailable the SAME function falls back to XOR-ing with an extern volatile global that holds zero, and identifies that global
states that MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is DERIVED rather than configured — it is set from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM together with compiler predefined macros, not from an entry in mbedtls_config.h
concludes that the PUBLIC API surface is a single function, mbedtls_ct_memcmp, while the rest of the primitives are library-internal
conveys that the primitives are consumed broadly across the library — on the order of twenty modules — rather than being confined to one or two
identifies that the constant-flow property is VERIFIED by a separate, off-by-default testing facility built on MemorySanitizer or valgrind, and that it is explicitly not part of the library API
the source files that make up the constant-time implementation — include/mbedtls/constant_time.h
the source files that make up the constant-time implementation — library/constant_time.c
the source files that make up the constant-time implementation — library/constant_time_internal.h
